in_hebrew.name: Kelsy
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kelsy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Kelso, meaning celestial or sky. In Christian tradition, represents a heavenly fighter or protector. The name was also used in ancient Greece for a person of noble birth or high status.

in_greek.name: Kelsy
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Celestial warrior
in_greek.long_meaning: Kelsy είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name Kelso, meaning celestial or sky. In Christian tradition, represents a heavenly fighter or protector. The name was also used in ancient Greece for a person of noble birth or high status.

in_latin.name: Kelsy
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Celestial warrior
in_latin.long_meaning: Kelsy est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name Kelso, meaning celestial or sky. In Christian tradition, represents a heavenly fighter or protector. The name was also used in ancient Greece for a person of noble birth or high status.
